SELECT payment_id AS paymentId,order_id AS orderId,store_id AS storeId,terminal_id AS terminalId, status,amount_minor AS amountMinor,currency,succeeded_refund_minor AS succeededRefundMinor, record_version AS recordVersion,occurred_at AS occurredAt FROM pay_payment_intent WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND payment_id=#{paymentId} FOR UPDATE

mapper.update: UPDATE pay_refund SET status=#{status},approver_user_id=COALESCE(#{approverId},approver_user_id), provider_refund_no=COALESCE(#{providerRefundNo},provider_refund_no),record_version=record_version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND refund_id=#{refundId} AND record_version=#{version}
mapper.select: SELECT a.provider_transaction_no AS reference,p.payment_id AS aggregateId,'PAYMENT' AS businessType, CASE WHEN p.status IN ('SUCCEEDED','PARTIALLY_REFUNDED','REFUNDED') THEN 'SUCCEEDED' ELSE p.status END AS status, p.amount_minor AS amountMinor,p.currency,p.occurred_at AS occurredAt FROM pay_payment_attempt a JOIN pay_payment_intent p ON p.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND p.payment_id=a.payment_id WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND a.provider_code=#{providerCode} AND a.provider_transaction_no=#{reference} UNION ALL SELECT r.provider_refund_no AS reference,r.refund_id AS aggregateId,'REFUND' AS businessType, r.status,r.amount_minor AS amountMinor,r.currency,r.occurred_at AS occurredAt FROM pay_refund r WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.provider_code=#{providerCode} AND r.provider_refund_no=#{reference} ORDER BY businessType,aggregateId

SELECT a.provider_transaction_no AS reference,p.payment_id AS aggregateId,'PAYMENT' AS businessType, 'SUCCEEDED' AS status,p.amount_minor AS amountMinor,p.currency,p.occurred_at AS occurredAt FROM pay_payment_attempt a JOIN pay_payment_intent p ON p.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND p.payment_id=a.payment_id WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND a.provider_code=#{providerCode} AND a.status='SUCCEEDED' AND p.occurred_at >=#{from} AND p.occurred_at <#{to} UNION ALL SELECT r.provider_refund_no AS reference,r.refund_id AS aggregateId,'REFUND' AS businessType, 'SUCCEEDED' AS status,r.amount_minor AS amountMinor,r.currency,r.occurred_at AS occurredAt FROM pay_refund r WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.provider_code=#{providerCode} AND r.status='SUCCEEDED' AND r.occurred_at >=#{from} AND r.occurred_at <#{to} ORDER BY reference,businessType
mapper.update: UPDATE pay_reconciliation_run SET status='COMPLETED',case_count=#{caseCount} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND run_id=#{runId} AND status='PROCESSING'
mapper.select: SELECT case_id AS caseId,run_id AS runId,difference_type AS differenceType, internal_reference AS internalReference,provider_reference AS providerReference,status, resolver_user_id AS resolverUserId,approver_user_id AS approverUserId,record_version AS recordVersion FROM pay_reconciliation_case WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND case_id=#{caseId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE pay_reconciliation_case SET status=#{status},resolver_user_id=COALESCE(#{resolverId},resolver_user_id), approver_user_id=COALESCE(#{approverId},approver_user_id), resolution_code=COALESCE(#{resolutionCode},resolution_code), resolution_text=COALESCE(#{resolutionText},resolution_text),record_version=record_version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND case_id=#{caseId} AND record_version=#{version}
